create_vit_small_model: create a ViT-small model with embed_dim 384, 12 layers, 6 attention heads, and optional register tokens
create_vit_base_model: create a ViT-base model with embed_dim 768, 12 layers, 12 attention heads, and optional register tokens
create_vit_large_model: create a ViT-large model with embed_dim 1024, 24 layers, 16 attention heads, and optional register tokens
create_vit_giant2_model: create a ViT-giant2 model with embed_dim 1536, 40 layers, 24 attention heads, and optional register tokens
build_vision_transformer_forward: build a forward pass through DinoVisionTransformer that returns normalized class token, register tokens, and patch tokens
